title: CPR-RAG
text: Chest CT 3D volumes are used for radiology report generation with RadGenome-ChestCT.

title: DEAR
text: The model generates radiology reports from 3D chest CT scans containing the lung.

title: PIPA
text: Radiology report generation uses 3D chest CT volumes from CT-RATE.

title: VolumeVision
text: Chest CT volumes and axial slices are used for automated radiology report generation.

title: SliceWorld
text: The system observes the axial sequence of a chest CT volume and generates its report.

title: ALTER
text: Longitudinal 3D chest CT from RadGenome-ChestCT is used for report generation.

title: MARCH
text: A multi-agent model generates radiology reports from volumetric chest CT.

title: DCP-PD
text: Long-form chest CT reports are generated from volumetric scans.

title: U-VLM
text: The model generates reports from 3D chest CT volumes in CT-RATE.

title: Structure Observation
text: CT-RATE chest CT volumes are inputs to radiology report generation.

title: DiffVP
text: volumetric chest CT from RadGenome-ChestCT is used to generate radiology reports.

title: CT-FineBench
text: The benchmark evaluates generated reports for 3D chest CT from CT-RATE.

title: CTEST-METRIC
text: The metric evaluates radiology reports for volumetric chest CT in CT-RATE.

title: VietPET-RoI
text: The model generates reports from whole-body PET/CT 3D volumes.

title: CT-Bench
text: The benchmark uses chest and abdominal CT with 2D-only input slices for VQA.

title: Merlin
text: The model uses 3D abdominal CT for radiology report generation.

title: SegReg-Rep
text: The model generates reports from 3D CT scans but the anatomy is not reported.
